2048.description: Classic sliding tile puzzle - combine numbers to reach 2048!
2048.usage: Use Arrow Keys or swipe to move tiles. When two tiles with the same number touch, they merge into one with their sum. Try to reach 2048!

Battle City.description: Classic tank battle game - destroy enemy tanks!
Battle City.usage: Use Arrow Keys, WASD, or swipe gestures to control your tank. Press Spacebar or double tap to shoot. Destroy enemy tanks to earn points. Avoid enemy bullets and walls. You have 3 lives - use them wisely!

Piano Tiles.description: Fast-paced rhythm game - tap falling tiles!
Piano Tiles.usage: Tap the black tiles as they fall down. Don't tap the white spaces! The game gets faster as your score increases. How far can you go?

Snake Game.description: Classic snake game - eat food and grow longer!
Snake Game.usage: Use Arrow Keys, WASD, or swipe gestures to control the snake. Eat the red food to grow longer and increase your score. Avoid hitting the walls or your own tail.

Tic Tac Toe.description: Classic 3x3 grid game - get 3 in a row!
Tic Tac Toe.usage: Click on any cell to place your mark (X or O). Players take turns, starting with X. First player to get 3 marks in a row (horizontal, vertical, or diagonal) wins.

2048.description: 经典滑动方块游戏 - 合并数字达到2048！
2048.usage: 使用方向键或滑动来移动方块。当两个相同数字的方块接触时，它们会合并成一个更大的数字。尝试达到2048！

坦克大战.description: 经典坦克大战游戏 - 摧毁敌方坦克！
坦克大战.usage: 使用方向键、WASD 或滑动手势控制你的坦克。按空格键或双击屏幕射击。摧毁敌方坦克获得分数。躲避敌方子弹和墙壁。你有 3 条生命 - 谨慎使用！

钢琴块.description: 快节奏节奏游戏 - 点击下落的方块！
钢琴块.usage: 当黑色方块落下时点击它们。不要点击白色区域！随着分数增加，游戏速度会变快。你能坚持多久？

贪吃蛇游戏.description: 经典贪吃蛇游戏 - 吃食物变长！
贪吃蛇游戏.usage: 使用方向键、WASD 或滑动手势控制蛇。吃红色食物变长并增加分数。避免撞墙或撞到自己的尾巴。

井字棋.description: 经典 3x3 棋盘游戏 - 三子连线获胜！
井字棋.usage: 点击任意格子放置你的标记（X 或 O）。玩家轮流进行，X 先手。第一个在行、列或对角线上连成三个标记的玩家获胜。
